title: Maximal filters in the lattice of closed convex sets: Lean 4 formalization
description: Paper and Lean 4 formalization. The closed convex subsets of R^n form a complete lattice under inclusion; its maximal filters are classified by an affine subspace A, a linear subspace W containing the direction space of A, and a vector space order on W in which that direction space is order-convex, subject to W = 0 when A is a point. Section 9 topologizes the set of maximal filters after Wallman and shows the resulting space is compact and T_1 but not Hausdorff; Section 10 shows that the algebra of functions converging along every maximal filter separates them. The development comprises 42 files and 842 declarations; every declaration compiles and its axiom profile is {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}.
